name: pulseops
description: PulseOps: API monitoring, latency analytics and evidence-driven incident investigation. Built on the MIT-licensed open-source api-monitor-saas (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w worker && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w core && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w core && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w core && npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w frontend
